trials.note: Test resources initially lacked shared-core transport; replacing a resource junction with real files fixed the fixture.
Initial toolkit copy/verification exceeded 30 seconds. Cold service requests now allow 180 seconds; warm requests retain their normal deadlines.
CLI one-second discovery could miss COM4; upload now allows ten seconds. CH343 without serial metadata restores only unchanged path and matching VID/PID.
readStringUntil with 100ms timeout and default RX buffer split/truncated a 4200-character message. Explicit 16KiB RX buffer plus newline accumulation passed both final rounds.

A direct compile without first-open initialization, concurrent with other initialization tests, failed with GCC multiple-input error. Recompile succeeded. The final cold run used the production inspect -> configure -> compile flow with no concurrent initialization and passed.
